privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Bee Store collects, uses and protects your personal data when you use this website, in line with Vietnam’s Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: When you create an account: full name, email, phone number (optional), preferred language and contact channel, and when you accepted the terms.
When you send a quote request or contact message: name, email, phone number, your message and the related product.
Technical data: IP address and browser, used for spam protection, rate limiting and account security.

sections.title: How we use it
paragraphs: To create and manage your account, verify your email and reset your password.
To contact you, advise you and send quotes through the channel you choose.
To protect the service from unauthorized access and abuse. We do not sell personal data or use it for third-party advertising.

sections.title: Storage and security
paragraphs: Data is stored on servers managed by Bee Store. Passwords are hashed with Argon2id, verification codes are stored only as hashes, and every connection uses HTTPS.
Database backups are encrypted and kept for at most 8 weeks.

sections.title: Sharing
paragraphs: We share data only with service providers needed to run the website (email delivery, spam protection with Cloudflare Turnstile, network infrastructure by Cloudflare) or when the law requires it.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can view and edit your details under My account, change your email, sign out of all devices and delete your account yourself. A deleted account is disabled immediately and its personal data is anonymized after 30 days.
To request a copy of your data or withdraw consent, write to sales@beegroupnas.com.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: The site uses strictly necessary cookies only: the sign-in session cookie (HttpOnly) and a cookie that remembers your language. We do not use advertising cookies.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy: sales@beegroupnas.com or hotline / WhatsApp +84 36 6789 371.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using the Bee Store website you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: The service
paragraphs: The website presents server and workstation parts and lets you read specifications, save products and request quotes. It does not take online payments; deals are agreed directly after a quote.

sections.title: Prices and product information
paragraphs: Displayed prices are reference prices in VND and may change with quantity, availability and time. The final price is the one in the official quote.
Specifications are compiled from manufacturer sources. We aim for accuracy but errors are possible.

sections.title: Deposit and payment
paragraphs: Bee Store takes a 50% deposit of the order value to confirm an order. Before taking the deposit, we check the price and availability with you.
For payment instructions, please contact our sales manager directly at +84 36 6789 371 (phone, Zalo or WhatsApp). The balance is paid on delivery.

sections.title: Accounts
paragraphs: You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for activity on your account. We may lock accounts that break these terms or show signs of abuse.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: No spam, no automated scraping that overloads the service, and no attempts to access the system without permission.

sections.title: Warranty and returns
paragraphs: Warranty and return conditions are stated in the quote and sales documents of each product.

sections.title: Images
paragraphs: Some product photos belong to third parties and are used under the licenses listed in each product’s “Image sources & licenses” section.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms; the date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

priceList.title: Excel price list
priceList.subtitle: Update prices and add products in bulk with the standard Excel file.
priceList.step1Body: The file has one sheet per category, pre-filled with every product, price and spec on the site. The "Hướng dẫn" sheet explains each column.
priceList.rule1: Edit prices, stock, status or specs right in the file. Do not edit the "Mã sản phẩm" (code) column.
priceList.rule2: Add a product as a new row with an empty code. Its code, name, specs and descriptions in 3 languages are generated; new products start as drafts so you can add images before publishing.
priceList.rule3: Press "Check" to preview the changes. Nothing is written while the file has errors.
priceList.confirmApply: Write these changes to the site?
priceList.applied: Import finished. Product pages refresh in a moment.
priceList.blocked: The file has errors, so nothing was written. Fix the rows marked in red and check again.
priceList.nothing: The file has no differences from the site.
priceList.newSubCategories: New product lines will be created: {list}
priceList.addImages: Open it to add images, then publish.

about.title: About us
about.headline: Connecting supply. Building trust.
about.lead: Bee Store is a distributor of server and workstation components: AMD EPYC CPUs, GPUs, mainboards, coolers and KVM over IP. For nearly 10 years we have been bringing products from mainland China to customers in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

story.title: Our journey
paragraphs: For almost a decade we have done one thing: connect the supply of one of the world's largest manufacturing markets with the needs of customers across the region. Sourcing, purchasing, shipping and cross-border distribution – we handle every step ourselves and learn from every order.

That journey taught us that customers need more than a fair price. They need to know exactly what they are buying, consistent prices and quality from one order to the next, and a distributor that keeps its word.

Bee Store is the next step on that journey. We focus on components for servers, home labs and AI systems, and bring the whole range to a modern store: clear specs, published prices and a team ready to advise on every build.
